question: What level of knowledge is attained by knowing the further half of this tantra?
premises: Someone may know the further half of this tantra.
Such a knower is declared all-knowing.
The verse explicitly removes doubt about this claim.
inference: One who knows the further half of this tantra is all-knowing without doubt.
plain_english: Whoever knows the further half of this tantra is all-knowing; there is no doubt.
